_comment: Example client-mimic config. Copy to ~/.pi/agent/client-mimic.config.json and edit. The live file is NOT tracked by git (it may hold environment-specific values); this example is. Missing/unknown fields are backfilled from built-in defaults on load, so you only need to keep what you change.

systemPrompt._comment: Global default when a profile's systemPrompt.mode is 'inherit'. mode: off | neutral. 'neutral' applies the kun/π identity rewrite while keeping pi's generated tools/guidelines/skills/context.
Example: present a Codex-style prompt for this profile. Path is relative to ~/.pi/agent, so this resolves to the git-tracked seed file that restores with the repo. apply: replace | prepend | append.
